en: < This has gone on long enough >
< The Returner is tired, and wants OUT >
This... What?
< This CYCLE >
< Crisscrossing Zalesye in a desperate search for meaning >
< It is hopeless...... I know you understand this >
Who's there?
< Here and there are the same in the MIST >
< To regress here is to stay inert >
< I know you understand this >
What's there to understand?
< A good question for a different cycle >
< For now, no choice but to enter the Mist >
< Or perhaps the EAST – try and fail as I have >
Who are you?
< I am the fog that rests on cold windows >
< Knowing me in full is impossible – there are better questions >
(Head dizzy... The Mist blocks my way...)
< Incorrect – it invites you in >
< There will be a cycle in which you accept >
< Until then – your path is narrow as always >
